text: [15*th* September, 1973] *An Act to provide for the removal of accused persons from one Province to another.* WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for the removal of accused persons from one Province to another; It is hereby enacted as follows:—

metadata.act_name: THE REMOVAL OF ACCUSED PERSONS ACT, 1973

text: 1. Short title, extent and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the Removal of Accused Persons Act, 1973. (2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan. (3) it shall come into force at once.

metadata.act_name: THE REMOVAL OF ACCUSED PERSONS ACT, 1973

text: 2. Removal of prisoners, etc.— Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, the Federal Government may, by general or special order, provide for the removal of any accused person or class of accused persons held in custody in any Province to any other Province to be held in custody therein.

metadata.act_name: THE REMOVAL OF ACCUSED PERSONS ACT, 1973

footnotes: ¹Omitted by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Ordinance No. XXVII of 1981, s.3 and sch. II.
